svg.text: Diagram F: Map and 3D Model Viewer (Read)
Get ready 2D file metadata for survey
Fetch Map Tile (every request authenticated + authorized)
Validate cookie + check project assignment for file's survey
Validate tile coords against private tile metadata
Generate short-lived signed URL for this tile
Get ready 3D file metadata for survey
Generate short-lived signed URL for 3D asset
- User not assigned to survey's project: 403 Forbidden
(applies to viewing, independent of approval status)
- File not yet processed (status != ready): 404 Not Found
- Tile coords out of bounds or invalid z/x/y: 400
- Signed URL expired mid-session: client re-requests the
tile or model endpoint for a fresh signed URL
- Original file download before approval: 403 Forbidden
- Viewer access requires only that the file is ready and
the user holds project assignment; approval status is
irrelevant to viewing, it only gates original-file
- Every tile request round-trips through Django for auth
and tile-bounds validation before a signed redirect is
issued; there is no direct, unauthenticated path to the
- Object storage is private; there is no public CDN in
- Model catalog authenticates once per request; the asset
bytes themselves are fetched directly from private
storage using the short-lived signed URL
- Dashed orange box: Drone Mapping Service boundary
- Colored modules inside the box are internal
- Auth is via HttpOnly cookie, not an Authorization header
